headline: Names a post office building in East Rochester, New York, after Officer Daryl R. Pierson.
what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service facility at 206 West Commercial Street in East Rochester, New York, as the "Officer Daryl R. Pierson Memorial Post Office Building." It is a naming measure only. It does not change postal services, rules, or staffing.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on November 5, 2015.
